Method of Attack: Exploiting zero-day RCE vulnerability CVE-2023-3519 in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway to plant web shells and steal Active Directory data
Impacted Systems: Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway servers
Attack Vector: Unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability exploitation
Indicators of Compromise: Web shell planted on non-production NetScaler ADC appliance
TGZ archive with web shell, discovery script, and setuid binary
Encrypted discovery data disguised as PNG image
